test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who is the chairperson of the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Vice-President of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Vice-President of India** is the **chairperson of the Rajya Sabha**.
 
• **Muppavarapu Venkaiah Naidu **is an Indian politician who has been serving as India's vice president since 2017.
 
• He formerly served in the Modi Cabinet as the minister of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation, Urban Development, and Information and Broadcasting.
 
• He was a senior member of the Bharatiya Janata Party and the party's national president from 2002 to 2004.
 
• He formerly served in the Atal Bihari Vajpayee cabinet as the Union Cabinet Minister for Rural Development.
 
• On August 11, 2017, he was sworn in as** the Vice President of India and Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.**
 
• He earned 516 votes, compared to 244 for UPA candidate **Gopalkrishna Gandhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The vice president of India** is the** deputy to the president of India**, who is the head of state of the Republic of India.
 
• After the president, the vice president is the second-highest constitutional office, ranking second in order of precedence and first in line of succession to the presidency.
 
• The vice president determines whether a bill is a money bill or not when it is introduced in the Rajya Sabha.
 
• He will send a measure filed in the Rajya Sabha to the Speaker of the Lok Sabha if he believes it is a money bill.
